description:
Perform a structural dynamic tuning of the NREL 5MW wind turbine blade to avoid resonance. 

1. Open QBlade and load the 'NREL 5MW' sample project from /home/ga/Documents/sample_projects/.
2. Navigate to the Blade Design module -> Modal Analysis to calculate the baseline 1st Flapwise Eigenfrequency (it should be around 0.6-0.7 Hz).
3. Modify the blade's structural properties (Stiffness) to increase this frequency. Target: > 0.75 Hz.
   - You can do this by scaling the Flapwise Stiffness (EIy) in the Structural Data tab, or by modifying the material properties if generating from cross-sections.
4. Run the Modal Analysis again to verify the new frequency is > 0.75 Hz.
5. Save the modified project as '/home/ga/Documents/projects/stiffened_blade.wpa'.
6. Create a report file at '/home/ga/Documents/projects/resonance_report.txt' containing the final frequency in Hz (e.g., 'New_Frequency: 0.78').
